name: Kave Compass
description: The household calendar: key dates, bookings, trips and what they cost.
_comment_colours: theme_color is absent on purpose, the same measured reason as Spoon's: setting it pins the status bar to ONE colour in both light and dark, while leaving it out lets the bar follow the phone. Chrome ignores <meta name=theme-color> in an installed app, and color_scheme_dark is not implemented. background_color only tints the launch splash and is the blue seed's light surface (#f9f9ff), since a manifest cannot read CSS variables.
